verdict.rationale: The product is a desktop app built around a coding agent. Users can delegate repo work to it, such as cloning, branching, committing, pushing and opening or reviewing PRs, from per-chat sessions with model and effort selection. Permission prompts or a full-permissions toggle govern its tool calls. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the delegation workflow beyond README snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
Choose a model and an effort level (low, high, xhigh, max) per chat.
The composer's full-permissions toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call.
